description: Put somebody of the company in a group of projects by hand — a person on none of its projects who should be offered in them — or take them out ('inGroup': false). Taking out removes only the hand-made place: somebody on one of the group's projects stays in it by being there. The company's administrator only. In the company's journal.

inGroup.description: True to put them in (the default), false to take them out.

name: set_project_group_person
title: Set project group person
